S. Maria della Pietà — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Santa Maria della Pietà is the former psychiatric hospital complex (closed after the 1978 Basaglia law), now a mix of Lazio regional offices, a park, and cultural/redevelopment projects reclaiming the historic pavilions. Recent coverage focuses entirely on restoration, regeneration and cultural programming, not crime or safety incidents. No specific safety concerns documented in recent local press for this area.
